name: Berserker Initiate
descr: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

data.motivesAndTactics: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon

features.name: Pack Fury
features.text: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.text: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.
